candidates.title: Alicja Kwade: Waiting Pavilions
candidates.blurb: Kwade's modular steel-and-glass structures occupy the former prison yard, collapsing public sculpture into functional architecture.

candidates.title: Ancient Egypt Unveiled: Treasures from Egyptian Museums
candidates.blurb: Egyptian state loans position Hong Kong as a neutral hub for non-Western antiquities diplomacy outside the Anglo-American circuit.

candidates.title: Treasures of Global Jewellery from The Metropolitan Museum of Art: The Body Transformed
candidates.blurb: Met partnership deploys global jewellery as soft-power material culture, framing ornament as anthropological continuity rather than luxury.

candidates.title: The Hong Kong Jockey Club Series: Treasures of the Mughal Court from the Victoria and Albert Museum
candidates.blurb: V&A's Mughal holdings stage Hong Kong as intermediary between South Asian heritage and Chinese audiences, bypassing London-Delhi frictions.

candidates.title: A Movable Feast: The Culture of Food and Drink in China
candidates.blurb: Palace Museum ceramics and ritual objects recast dining as curatorial subject, testing whether material culture can carry social history.

candidates.title: Proudly from Canton: The Muwen Tang Collection of Cantonese and Export Art
candidates.blurb: Cantonese export painting reframes Hong Kong's colonial-era intermediary role as aesthetic category, not just economic fact.
candidates.why_shortlisted: Local specificity, export art as Hong Kong genre

candidates.title: Fermata: Hong Kong in Venice, Collateral Event of the 61st International Art Exhibition – La Biennale di Venezia
candidates.blurb: Venice Biennale collateral returns to Hong Kong, reversing the exhibition circuit to test what 'Hong Kong pavilion' means at home.

candidates.title: Live: Hong Kong Art Exhibition
candidates.blurb: Public museum survey attempts to codify 'Hong Kong art' as institutional category, risking both coherence and oversimplification.

candidates.title: Wu Guanzhong Art Sponsorship Cross-disciplinary Series: Light Entry
candidates.blurb: Cross-disciplinary commission uses Wu's ink abstraction as licence to test whether modernist painting can anchor contemporary installation.

candidates.title: Joyful Encounters: The Connoisseurship and Art of Wong Kwan Shut
candidates.blurb: Scholar-collector monograph foregrounds Hong Kong's literati lineage, positioning connoisseurship as local institutional identity.

candidates.title: A History of China in Silk: The Chris Hall Collection at the Hong Kong Palace Museum
candidates.blurb: Western collector's silk trove narrates Chinese history through material culture, testing whether textiles can carry historiographical weight.

candidates.title: The Hong Kong Jockey Club Series: A Day in the City — An Experimental Study of Things Across Time
candidates.blurb: Experimental thematic juxtaposes imperial and contemporary objects across a single day's temporal structure, risking gimmick or revelation.

candidates.title: Heavenly Horses: Masterpieces from the Palace Museum
candidates.blurb: Equine iconography as lens for Silk Road exchange and imperial power, testing whether a single motif can sustain year-long focus.
